NoTarget.label: "No Target" gizmo
NoTarget.description: Adds a toggle gizmo to hostile pawns to exempt them from auto-targeting by colonists and turrets. Forced attacks will still work as normal. Hostile pawns with positive relations to colonists are automatically marked. Blood relatives receive a permanent mark, while others receive a temporary one (duration configurable below).

CaptureAsJob.label: "Capture" gizmo
CaptureAsJob.description: Adds a "Capture" toggle to pawns available for capture. When enabled, wardens will automatically attempt to capture the pawn if a prisoner bed is available.

AmbrosiaAutoHarvest.label: Ambrosia auto harvest
AmbrosiaAutoHarvest.description: Automatically designates ambrosia bushes for harvest when they become harvestable.

ShipChunkAutoDeconstruct.label: Ship chunk auto deconstruct
ShipChunkAutoDeconstruct.description: Automatically designates ship chunks (including gravship wreckage) for deconstruction when they appear.

DelayedQuestAcceptance.label: Delayed quest acceptance
DelayedQuestAcceptance.description: Replaces quest accept buttons with configurable delayed acceptance controls so offers can be accepted automatically later.

ConstructionPriority.label: Construction priority
ConstructionPriority.description: Adds a priority gizmo to player-owned construction blueprints and frames so builders and haulers prefer higher-priority construction targets.

PendingPassenger.label: Pending passenger
PendingPassenger.description: In the vehicle passenger tab, show pawns currently boarding (or queued to board) as pending entries with a cancel button. Requires Vehicle Framework.

AutoNoTargetForPrisonerRelatives.label: Include prisoner relations
AutoNoTargetForPrisonerRelatives.description: When enabled, hostile pawns with positive relations to your prisoners will also be automatically marked as "No Target".

DefaultNoTargetMarkTtl.label: Manual mark duration
DefaultNoTargetMarkTtl.description: The duration (in hours) for the "No Target" mark when applied manually via the gizmo. Set to 0 for a permanent mark.

UseUnifiedConstructionDelivery.label: Unify blueprint and frame delivery
UseUnifiedConstructionDelivery.description: When enabled, replaces vanilla blueprint/frame resource delivery scanners with a unified scanner so construction priority is compared across both target types.

NoTarget.label: No Target
NoTarget.description: Prevent colonists and turrets from auto-targeting this pawn.

Capture.label: Capture
Capture.description: Wardens will capture this downed pawn when a prisoner bed is available.

Commands.Label: Priority
Commands.Description: Set construction priority for this blueprint or frame.
